description: This line plot illustrates three metrics—Final Accuracy, Δ Accuracy, and Initial Accuracy—across a range of model parameters from 0.71 to 1.00, with accuracy values scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0 on the y-axis. The x-axis represents these parameters, labeled numerically from 0.71 to 1.00 in increments of 0.01. The blue line, representing Final Accuracy, begins at approximately 0.90, rises to a peak of 1.00 near 0.79, then fluctuates slightly before settling near 0.90 at the end. The green dashed line, representing Initial Accuracy, starts near 0.55, rises to about 0.90 near 0.79, then declines to approximately 0.80 at the end. The orange dashed line, representing Δ Accuracy, starts near 0.35, drops to approximately 0.05 near 0.73, then exhibits significant volatility with peaks and troughs, including a low near 0.00 at 0.90 and a peak near 0.40 at 0.92, before declining to approximately 0.05 at 1.00. All three lines are plotted with error bars indicating variability.
